cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Our garden door opens into the broom cupboard. Wonderful, we can take a brush for the picnic crumbs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the attic. I'm carrying all the sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Perfect. Grab the picnic blanket without climbing stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the cellar. The sandwiches are getting warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Built-in refrigeration. Put them beside the wine; this door is catering.

mechanism: A declares which failure counts as useful and directs B accordingly, treating requests to stop or reverse the impossible system as decisions for A to make.
confusable: Generic optimism is confusable: each specific malfunction must supply the benefit, and A assumed precedence must govern whether or how B uses it.
comparison: The picnic alternative controls a shared outing through a wandering door; the office alternative gives a junior colleague terms for handling backward time and a superior.
seedUse: Read all four canonical seeds. Use the door picnic and backward office clock as context; make B requests and A decisions carry the status rather than generic prefatory claims.
